newsitem.title: USA: Summa Four sees Q1 shr loss $0.04 to $0.14.
newsitem.headline: Summa Four sees Q1 shr loss $0.04 to $0.14.

text.p: Summa Four Inc said Monday it expects to record a first quarter loss of $0.04 to $0.14 per share versus a profit of $0.12 per share a year ago.

Company president and chief executive officer Bob Degan said, "this quarter has been marked by the absence of our typical one or two larger deals. Several of our more sizable opportunites entering the quarter have been delayed or are expected to be received as bookings only."
The company said it will report actual results for the quarter ended June 30 on about July 15.
